difficulty_reason: Y' amalga Z -> Y is proper surjective, so it suffices to produce descent data for that cover from an object of the fibre-product category: define F on the disjoint union summand-wise; over Y' x_Y Y' = Y' x_Y Y' amalga E amalga E amalga Z the pullback identifications are immediate on three summands, and the interesting pr_0^{-1}G' -> pr_1^{-1}G' is built using that h : Y amalga (E x_Z E) -> Y' x_Y Y' is surjective proper (finite, being two closed immersions), so it suffices to give the isomorphism after pullback by h - the diagonal piece is canonical and the E x_Z E piece is the pullback of G; the cocycle condition follows the same way ('we omit the details', mechanisms named for both pieces); conclude with lemma-glue-etale-sheaf-proper-surjective.
